Senses.PreferredTarget: to take it up sideways and use it upside down
SearchAliases: to take it up sideways and use it upside down
Senses.Note: Different orientations remain one handling, not separate senses.

Occurrences.Kwic: 林把做誵訛看，殊不知歸宗老人坐在活脫無依處，所以橫拈倒用，一切自由。你若未見此老落處，安知此老用處？既未
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X70/X70n1403.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Tianru Weize (天如惟則禪師語錄). Speaker: Tianru Weize.

Occurrences.Kwic: 易是甚麼人？良久曰：聻。便下座。上堂，拈拄杖曰：橫拈倒用，撥開彌勒眼睛。明去暗來，敲落祖師鼻孔。當是時也

Occurrences.Kwic: 甚麼人？良久，云：聻！便下座。上堂，拈拄杖，曰：橫拈倒用，撥開彌勒眼睛；明去暗來，敲落祖師鼻孔。當是時也
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X81/X81n1568.xml). Strict Lineage of the Five Lamps (Vols. 10–25) (五燈嚴統(第10卷-第25卷)). Speaker: Huanglong Huinan.

Senses.Explanation: Taking something up sideways and using it upside down names free handling that refuses a fixed orientation. Huanglong raises his staff with the phrase, Tianru applies it to Guizong’s freedom in the snake case, and Tianyin says the staff fits every such handling.
